timeline.event: Deep into systems programming — Go, Rust

bio: I'm a full-stack engineer who treats code like infrastructure — it should be reliable, observable, and built to scale. I work across the entire stack, from pixel-perfect interfaces to distributed backend systems.
My approach is systems-first: understand the problem domain deeply, then architect solutions that are maintainable and performant. I don't build MVPs — I build foundations.
Currently focused on distributed systems, developer tooling, and real-time applications. When I'm not shipping code, I'm contributing to open source or writing about software architecture.
